claim_scope: Classical fixed-anchor jet upper group, with full equality certified by zero kernel, T <= 1, or exact propagation; no hardness promise

cases.name: dense_generic_quadratic
cases.group: product UT_b(F_p), consecutive diagonal blocks, x -> g x
cases.equality_semantics: formal polynomial equality over F_p, not pointwise function equality
cases.finite_jet_stabilizer: {exp(sum_i t_i K_i): t_i in F_p}, K_i from kernel_basis
cases.degree_bound_description: 2^T is an upper bound, not the actual degree

resources.matrix_products: Dense D-by-D loops, O(D^3) per product; no sparse multiplication
resources.jet_field_operations: O(k (T+1) D^4), k = number of anchors
resources.generator_exponential_field_operations: O(s b D^3), s = kernel_dimension; dense truncated matrix powers
resources.propagation_per_generator_field_operatio: O(b^2 D^3); two dense products plus explicit block-index quadratic loops
resources.bit_cost_note: Exact modular arithmetic on O(log p)-bit field elements; prime validation also charged
